issues.title: Define the authoring workflow and approve editor interaction prototypes

requirements.description: Task-based setup and authoring workflow

issues.problem: The current Inspector/overlay exposes technical settings without a coherent first-use journey.
issues.solution: Produce original wireframes and a task/state specification for target setup, layer selection, paint, sculpt, create, materials and output. Preserve Scene-view EditorTool integration; approve layouts before implementation.
success: Document empty, unsupported, mixed-selection, editing, preview, dirty and error states.
Separate common controls from advanced options; show clear active mode/target and explain every disabled action.
Owner reviews clickable or native prototypes at narrow/wide panel widths and both editor themes.
Define five-minute first-use script and baseline task timings; do not copy another product's branding or layout.
issues.verification: Record prototype review and revisions, not screenshot-only approval.

issues.title: Implement a unified workspace and guided target/material setup

requirements.description: Unified workspace, contextual fixes and layer thumbnails
Layer-based and direct RGBA workflows with reusable palettes

issues.problem: Users must manually connect component, tool, mesh and material state.
issues.solution: Implement the approved workspace and a compact Scene-view tool surface backed by the existing brush settings. Provide explicit prepare-copy and material-creation actions, named layers, thumbnails and direct RGBA mode.
success: No silent material, importer, mesh or pipeline mutation during selection.
Fix actions describe what will change, support cancellation and preserve originals.
Palette/profile assets persist and can be shared without storing per-user preferences in the package.
First-stroke flow works on a generated wall and an imported multi-material mesh.
issues.verification: Editor-state tests plus owner walkthrough using fresh settings.

issues.title: Add coherent shortcuts, selection lock and trustworthy live feedback

requirements.description: Size, strength, sensitivity, capped/continuous strokes and shortcuts
Channel/result previews, selection lock and multi-material feedback

issues.problem: Mouse-heavy controls and unclear tool ownership slow painting and make mode errors hard to diagnose.
issues.solution: Implement configurable Shortcut Manager commands, modifier erase, radius/strength gestures, selection locking and contextual tooltips. Preserve capped/continuous semantics and distinguish vertex alpha from brush strength.
success: One gesture produces one Undo; erase respects strength and target channels.
Paint/sculpt shortcuts coexist with navigation and text fields; closing/deactivating the tool releases input.
Keyboard focus, readable theme contrast and non-color-only channel labels are verified.
Preview is isolated, identifies the affected material/submesh and never dirties source materials.
issues.verification: Input/state regression tests and recorded shortcut/focus/theme checks.

issues.title: Add textured stamps and reusable brush presets

requirements.description: Alpha stamps with rotation and inversion

issues.problem: The brush cannot stamp authored coverage patterns.
issues.solution: Add coverage textures, rotation, inversion and saved presets with explicit texture-readability handling; retain flow, falloff, channel masks and per-stroke caps.
success: A known red-channel stamp produces expected coverage at rotated orientations.
Preview matches applied coverage on transformed meshes and seams.
Cancelling readability repair changes no importer; any approved change is disclosed.
Presets survive reload and do not retain stale scene-object references.
issues.verification: Deterministic stamp fixtures and an original wear/stain demonstration.

issues.title: Add deterministic procedural dirt, grime and edge masks

requirements.description: Seeded full-surface and border/UV-edge procedural painting

issues.problem: Large-area weathering currently requires repeated manual strokes.
issues.solution: Add seeded noise and border-distance operations with coverage, width, softness and strength controls, isolated preview, randomize, apply and cancel.
success: Mesh borders and UV seams are separate selectable edge sources.
Preview/cancel changes no authoritative colors, files or Undo history.
Apply is one reversible operation with unchanged unselected channels/submeshes.
Identical inputs and seed yield identical output across reloads.
issues.verification: Known topology/UV fixtures, deterministic checksums and saved-scene acceptance.

issues.title: Make brush targeting surface-aware and submesh-aware

requirements.description: Automatic visible-submesh targeting and explicit submesh lock

issues.problem: A radius-only operation can affect nearby hidden surfaces or the wrong material section.
issues.solution: Provide visible-hit submesh routing, front/back and connected-surface controls, explicit through-paint mode and material-aware palette updates. Preserve existing normal/value masks.
success: Thin-wall, overlapping-shell and double-sided fixtures do not paint behind the visible hit by default.
Automatic mode follows the hit material; locked mode cannot leak into another section.
Mirrored/nonuniform transforms and skinned-pose targets have documented behavior.
No MeshCollider is required for painting; selection preview uses the same rules as apply.
issues.verification: Geometry-targeting tests plus thin-wall and multi-material visual checks.

issues.title: Implement exact manual mask packing and import profiles

requirements.description: Manual mask packing, defaults, roughness conversion and HDRP profile

issues.problem: Users must prepare packed PBR data externally.
issues.solution: Add a manual packer with explicit channel sources, fallback values, output sizing and profiles for SimpleBlend metallic/AO/height/smoothness and HDRP Lit metallic/AO/detail/smoothness.
success: Known pixel values remain correct in linear data space; roughness inversion is opt-in and explicit.
Resolution, resize filtering, compression and missing-input defaults are inspectable.
Source texture bytes and importer settings remain unchanged after success, cancellation and failure.
Output paths are validated; overwriting generated outputs requires explicit confirmation.
issues.verification: Pixel-level GPU/CPU packing fixtures, color-space checks and importer/source hashes.

issues.title: Add texture-set discovery and safe batch material preparation

requirements.description: Folder discovery, suffix matching, batch preparation and optional source cleanup

issues.problem: Preparing many materials manually is slow and ambiguous filenames can corrupt grouping.
issues.solution: Discover texture sets using configurable suffix rules with per-folder identity, preview ambiguous candidates and support already-packed maps. Offer an optional reviewed cleanup operation only after successful output verification.
success: Same base names in different folders never combine accidentally.
Smoothness/gloss precedence over roughness is explicit; ambiguous generic masks require confirmation.
Optional source cleanup defaults off, uses recoverable Trash/Recycle Bin and provides a manifest; unavailable recovery disables cleanup.
Albedo, normal, emission, skipped inputs and failed-set sources are never cleanup targets; deletion is not presented as Unity Undo.
issues.verification: Ambiguous-folder fixtures, dry-run manifest checks and injected output failures.

issues.title: Build stable texture-array libraries and material conversion

requirements.description: Reusable array libraries and non-destructive standard-to-array conversion

issues.problem: Materials cannot share a stable reusable texture library.
issues.solution: Add versioned array-library assets with stable slice identities, ordered material-set selection, memory estimates and conversion from supported existing SimpleBlend layer materials.
success: Rebuild/add/remove never silently reassigns an existing material to different textures.
Array dimensions/formats/mips and normal/data decoding are validated.
Conversion creates new materials/libraries and preserves source materials/textures; unsupported properties produce a report.
Shared libraries, safe missing-input fallbacks, interrupted writes and rollback have tests.
Single and batch conversion preserve supported material flags and produce per-material fallback/unsupported-property reports.
issues.verification: Library identity tests and before/after renderer comparisons in clean consumers.

issues.title: Add five-layer URP blending without breaking existing channel profiles

requirements.description: Base plus four overlays in URP

issues.problem: Current URP shaders support at most base plus three overlays.
issues.solution: Add a separately identified five-layer profile using all RGBA weights and bounded/shared samplers. Retain existing three/four-layer material contracts unchanged.
success: Five distinct layers are independently paintable; zero weights and normalization have numerical fixtures.
Legacy alpha-free materials are never reinterpreted automatically.
Forward/deferred/depth/shadow/normal/Meta passes and player stripping are verified.
Publish measured sampler/variant limits and exact supported graphics APIs; resolve the older-manual/newer-listing discrepancy with SimpleBlend evidence.
issues.verification: GPU math probes, five-layer reference captures and retained-variant player builds.

issues.title: Deliver optional HDRP three-layer and five-layer shaders

requirements.description: HDRP three/five-layer material workflows

issues.problem: The package is currently URP-only.
issues.solution: Provide isolated HDRP shader/integration assets with no forced HDRP installation in URP/Built-in projects. Share pipeline-independent blend math and explicit material profiles.
success: HDRP can be absent without import or compilation failures.
Three/five-layer materials render correctly in supported forward/deferred/shadow/depth and baked-lighting configurations.
Unsupported combinations fail with a capability explanation rather than pink shaders presented as support.
Migration produces new material assets and does not change project pipeline settings.
Separate core/editor and pipeline integrations so the existing URP dependency does not force URP into HDRP or Built-in consumers; preserve current install migration.
issues.verification: Clean with/without-HDRP imports, player builds and pipeline-specific render captures.

issues.title: Deliver a Built-in three-layer fallback and capability guidance

requirements.description: Built-in three-layer blending with variation

issues.problem: Full baseline parity requires a Built-in workflow as well as SRP support.
issues.solution: Add a basic Built-in three-layer material variant with variation and explicit limitations; isolate pipeline dependencies.
success: Paint/create/sculpt tools import without SRP packages.
Three material layers and supported variation controls have render evidence.
Users see the capability difference before choosing unavailable shaders.
A clean Built-in consumer imports, paints, saves and builds without changing pipeline settings.
Expose stable contrast/blend controls with a validated default instead of requiring unexplained trial-and-error tuning.
issues.verification: Built-in consumer tests and scene/player screenshots.

issues.title: Add variation and painted wetness with explicit semantic profiles

requirements.description: Material variation, painted wetness and optional wetness mask

issues.problem: Raw overlay weights alone cannot express wet surfaces or reusable A/B variation.
issues.solution: Add a versioned three-layer profile with separate semantic controls for variation and wetness, including mask-limited wetness. Define its channel mapping explicitly and keep existing paint profiles intact.
success: Dry/wet and A/B extremes plus intermediate values have GPU fixtures.
No-mask behavior is stable and documented; mask red coverage limits wetness predictably.
Five-layer profiles cannot silently reuse occupied channels for wetness/variation.
Palette labels and shader/material inspectors agree on profile semantics.
issues.verification: Reference materials and dry/damp/puddle-like samples under controlled lighting.

issues.title: Add UV/triplanar, bounded parallax and painted cutout variants

requirements.description: UV/triplanar mapping and parallax occlusion
Painted overlay alpha cutout

issues.problem: The material toolkit lacks important surface mapping and reveal effects.
issues.solution: Add UV/triplanar selection, bounded POM using packed height and an explicit cutout overlay variant. Scope silhouettes and depth/shadow correctness separately from ordinary UV parallax.
success: POM has step/quality limits, grazing-angle handling and a zero-height bypass.
Triplanar normals remain correct under transforms and consistent across supported passes.
Cutout uses the intended overlay's texture alpha and threshold; shadow/depth/Meta behavior is tested.
Publish per-pipeline/API capabilities and measured quality/performance tradeoffs.
issues.verification: UV-less, grazing-view, cutout-shadow and bake fixtures with fixed-camera references.

issues.title: Connect array-backed materials and reusable Shader Graph integration

requirements.description: Array-backed URP/HDRP materials
Configurable custom-shader mappings and reusable graph functions

issues.problem: A texture library has no value without correctly wired shaders and artist-visible mappings.
issues.solution: Implement array-backed three-layer URP/HDRP materials with stable slice selection, wetness/variation/mapping integration and documented reusable graph functions. Add explicit custom property/channel profiles.
success: Array and separate-texture materials match for the same inputs within recorded render tolerance.
Materials sharing arrays can select different slices without rebuilding or changing library identities.
Custom mappings validate missing/wrong-type properties and never guess destructive conversions.
Player builds retain required graph variants; absent optional pipelines do not break core import.
issues.verification: Cross-path GPU/reference tests, custom-shader sample and consumer builds.

issues.title: Introduce owned editable geometry state and complete persistence

requirements.description: Saved geometry, attributes, topology and material-section state

issues.problem: The current color-authority component and copy subdivision are not a full geometry editor.
issues.solution: Design and implement an owned editable-mesh data contract for positions, all supported UVs, normals/tangents, colors and submesh buffers, separate from immutable imported sources.
success: Schema migration preserves existing VertexPaintData scenes/prefabs or rejects safely with recovery instructions.
Independent instances, prefab overrides, Prefab Mode, reload and Play Mode preserve geometry and paint.
Source FBX/builtin meshes remain byte-/data-identical; mesh ownership is visible.
One geometry gesture is one Undo; cached paint/raycast data invalidates after geometry edits.
issues.verification: Serialization/migration/prefab/lifecycle/source-hash fixtures.

issues.title: Add checkpoints, pose/topology revert and explicit paint reprojection

requirements.description: Pose/topology restoration with paint-preserving recovery

issues.problem: Geometry edits need a reliable way back without silently attaching colors to unrelated indices.
issues.solution: Provide original/working checkpoints, pose revert, topology revert and previewable color reprojection with confidence/rejection reporting.
success: Topology restoration reinstates source submeshes/UVs and does not edit the imported source.
Unmatched or ambiguous regions are visible before apply; users can cancel without mutation.
Do not claim pose revert can reconstruct topology; use separate restore operations.
Restored data survives reopen and Undo/Redo; retained recovery assets are explained.
issues.verification: Deform/refine/remove/revert chains and intentionally ambiguous projection fixtures.

issues.title: Implement pull, push, smooth, nudge and axis flatten brushes

requirements.description: Sculpt brush family with strength and pose revert

issues.problem: Artists cannot shape environment meshes within the current tool.
issues.solution: Add surface-direction pull/push, relaxation smooth, hit-plane nudge, local-axis flatten and pose revert using owned geometry, shared brush UX and explicit boundary behavior.
success: Strength/falloff/spacing and modifier behavior are consistent across tools.
Welded seam groups move coherently without joining unrelated coincident shells.
Nonuniform/mirrored transforms, boundaries and masked sections have regression fixtures.
Each stroke is undoable, previewable and saved without altering imported or shared source meshes.
issues.verification: Known displacement/smoothing fixtures and user sculpt-session observations.

issues.title: Add local refinement with safe attribute and boundary handling

requirements.description: Localized triangle refinement

issues.problem: Whole-mesh subdivision is not local detail authoring.
issues.solution: Refine selected brush regions with owned geometry, seam-aware attribute interpolation and conforming boundary handling. Retain whole-mesh copy as a distinct preparation action.
success: Local refine introduces no unintended cracks or hanging edges on supported manifold inputs.
UV dimensions, paint, normals/tangents and submesh assignments remain valid.
Count/memory estimates, budgets and cancellation are available before expensive work.
Unsupported or degenerate inputs fail before committing geometry.
issues.verification: Boundary adjacency, seam, material, budget and rollback tests.

issues.title: Add circle/square face removal and controlled rim adjustment

requirements.description: Front-facing removal brushes and existing-rim rounding

issues.problem: Users cannot cut surface openings interactively.
issues.solution: Implement circle and touched-face square removal with front-facing targeting, optional existing-boundary rounding and a clear distinction from volume booleans.
success: Faces partially touched by square selection are handled consistently.
Double-sided surfaces do not accidentally lose back faces.
Rim rounding moves only eligible boundary vertices and never claims to add missing geometry.
One stroke is one Undo; attributes/submeshes persist and original assets remain unchanged.
issues.verification: Door/window, curved rim and double-sided mesh fixtures.

issues.title: Add vertex, edge and face selection with transform handles

requirements.description: Element move, rotate and scale

issues.problem: Brush deformation cannot replace precise local element edits.
issues.solution: Provide explicit vertex/edge/face modes with add/subtract selection and native move/rotate/scale handles; expose pivot/orientation choices and seam grouping.
success: Coincident seam vertices move coherently under an explicit weld-group policy.
Selection respects occlusion/through-selection settings and material sections.
Handle gestures support cancel and one-step Undo without stealing navigation.
Topology changes invalidate selections safely; no stale-index writes occur.
issues.verification: Transform/pivot/selection fixtures plus mixed-scale scene walkthrough.

issues.title: Add normals, tangents, UV repair and mesh diagnostics

requirements.description: Normals/tangents recalculation, secondary UV repair and statistics

issues.problem: Geometry changes can invalidate shading and lightmap UVs without an actionable diagnostic.
issues.solution: Add mesh statistics, invalid/degenerate topology checks, explicit normal/tangent recalculation and generated-copy secondary-UV repair. Preserve primary UVs by default.
success: Hard edges and UV seams follow an explicit normal/weld policy.
Lightmap UV generation never overwrites source/importer data or primary UV channels.
Users see vertex/triangle/material counts and budget warnings before expensive actions.
A repaired scene bakes and renders with recorded evidence; unsupported geometry receives a useful report.
issues.verification: Attribute invariants, degenerate fixtures and baked-lighting consumer checks.

issues.title: Create density-controlled floors and surface/solid/profile walls

requirements.description: Floor and surface/solid/custom-profile wall generators

issues.problem: Users need ready-to-paint environment geometry rather than manual sparse primitives.
issues.solution: Generate floors and wall variants with physical size, thickness/profile, verts-per-meter, pivot, UV scale/rotation and material controls.
success: Size/density/triangle estimates match generated geometry.
Solid walls are closed with correctly wound end/reveal faces and useful material sections.
Profile walls validate self-intersections and invalid dimensions before generation.
Generated assets are unique, save/reopen correctly and can be painted/sculpted immediately.
issues.verification: Analytical bounds/topology/UV/pivot fixtures and wall-first lesson.

issues.title: Create curved walls and inward/outward beveled boxes

requirements.description: Curved walls and configurable boxes

issues.problem: Environment blockout needs curved boundaries and room-like volumes.
issues.solution: Add arc curvature/completeness/pivot controls and box generation with inside/outside orientation, optional caps and bounded bevel segments.
success: Curvature/completeness and pivots match requested dimensions.
Inward/outward winding and normal direction are correct.
Bevels/caps preserve manifold structure where requested and avoid duplicate degenerate faces.
UV scale and material sections remain stable as density changes.
issues.verification: Geometry invariants and painted room/curved-wall samples.

issues.title: Generate spline tunnels and profile-based structures

requirements.description: Spline-based structures with profiles, caps and separate floors

issues.problem: Procedural creation cannot follow paths.
issues.solution: Add an optional Unity Splines adapter with bounded sampling, orientation frames, profile presets, caps and optional separate floor output.
success: Splines package is optional and license-reviewed; core package imports when absent.
Open/closed paths and tight bends have explicit validity checks and seam handling.
Preview and generated output agree; materials, density and UV distance are predictable.
Changes produce owned outputs with undoable replacement, not mutation of shared imported assets.
issues.verification: Straight/curved/closed/twisted-path fixtures and clean no-Splines import.

issues.title: Add responsive creation previews, placement and snapping

requirements.description: Bounded smart preview, placement layers and increment snapping

issues.problem: Large procedural previews can stall the editor or accidentally create assets.
issues.solution: Add coarse-to-fine previews, explicit generation, raycast-layer placement, grid/increment snapping and triangle/memory estimates.
success: Dragging parameters does not create permanent assets or Undo spam.
Cancel/deactivate releases preview resources and input.
Preview budgets prevent unbounded geometry growth and show when preview resolution differs from final output.
Placement/pivot/snapping operate consistently on transformed scene surfaces.
issues.verification: Repeated preview/cancel allocation tests and timed large-generator interaction.

issues.title: Implement validated single and atomic multi-target boolean subtraction

requirements.description: Closed-cutter boolean subtraction, open/interior options and batch Undo

issues.problem: Surface deletion cannot create precise volumetric openings.
issues.solution: Implement an independently authored or permissively licensed subtraction kernel with input validation, tolerance/resource budgets, optional open cut/interior material and cut-vertex color. Provide selected-cutter assignment, reviewed intersecting-target discovery and reversible hide-cutter-after-success controls.
success: Readable closed-volume operands with actual overlap have deterministic validated results.
Input validation and complete output preflight precede an atomic multi-target commit.
Any target failure/cancellation leaves every target, cutter visibility and source asset unchanged.
Successful batches use one Undo; interiors, submeshes, attributes and collider refresh are correct.
issues.verification: Manifold/intersection/degenerate/coplanar/negative-scale fixtures, resource-limit and injected failure tests.

issues.title: Cut solid-wall doors/windows with materialized reveal faces

requirements.description: Grid-aligned through-wall openings and interior submeshes

issues.problem: Deleting front faces from a thick wall leaves back faces and missing reveals.
issues.solution: Use generated solid-wall metadata to remove aligned front/back cells and build door/window reveals with optional separate interior material; retain normal surface-remove behavior elsewhere.
success: Only eligible generated solid walls expose the grid-aware thickness operation.
Opening dimensions, winding, UVs and interior material indices are correct.
Surface walls and arbitrary meshes are not misidentified as solid generators.
Repeated openings, edges/corners and Undo/Redo preserve valid saved geometry.
issues.verification: Closed-wall topology checks and lit door/window sample.

issues.title: Transfer paint to revised meshes with match and projection previews

requirements.description: Static mesh revision transfer with position/projection modes

issues.problem: Source revisions currently invalidate paint without a recovery workflow.
issues.solution: Add previewed position matching and optional nearest-surface/barycentric projection, distance/normal filters and unmatched diagnostics; create a separate painted destination copy.
success: Original and revised source meshes/data remain unchanged.
Split seams, transforms, multiple submeshes and partial overlap have explicit handling.
Ambiguous/unmatched regions can be rejected or assigned a deliberate fallback.
Transfer is cancelable and undoable; result survives prefab/save/reload.
issues.verification: Known correspondence/error bounds and adversarial thin-shell fixtures.

issues.title: Bake standalone painted/sculpted meshes and remove storage safely

requirements.description: Permanent mesh bake, lightmap UVs and optional component removal

issues.problem: Painted or sculpted objects cannot yet be finalized independently of authoring storage.
issues.solution: Bake owned geometry and RGBA to a uniquely named mesh, update renderer/collider references deliberately and offer optional authoring-component removal after verified success.
success: Source imported and working data remain recoverable; no unrelated collider is replaced silently.
UVs, skinning where supported, submeshes, materials and lightmap UVs follow documented capability rules.
Baked meshes render without authoring components; shader dependencies are reported separately.
Failed writes/removal roll back scene references; clean-project/package-removal checks pass.
issues.verification: Bake/reopen/prefab/player/removal tests in disposable consumers.

issues.title: Add optional ProBuilder paint synchronization and ownership guards

requirements.description: ProBuilder inbound/outbound paint sync and topology-owner protection

issues.problem: Competing mesh owners can overwrite paint or compiled topology.
issues.solution: Add an optional ProBuilder adapter with explicit send/sync actions and stroke-completion synchronization; block incompatible storage-side topology edits/baking until ownership is finalized.
success: Core imports without ProBuilder and the adapter uses public version-checked APIs.
Recompile/refresh/reopen preserves colors and face-material assignments.
Paint sync never replaces ProBuilder topology; external topology edits invalidate or explicitly reconcile mappings.
Guard messages explain how to finalize ownership without destroying source data.
issues.verification: ProBuilder edit/paint/refresh/prefab/Undo fixtures and missing-package compile check.

issues.title: Add reusable non-destructive paint layers and mask recipes

requirements.description: Named editable paint layers and reusable procedural recipes

issues.problem: Destructive color accumulation makes iteration and reuse expensive.
issues.solution: Add independently editable paint-operation layers/recipes with names, visibility, opacity, reorder and explicit flatten/bake. Keep evaluated Color32 data as a compatible renderer output.
success: Layer evaluation is deterministic and versioned; masks/profile semantics remain explicit.
Flatten preserves appearance and retains an optional editable source.
Topology changes invalidate or reproject layers only through a previewed action.
Reopen/prefab/Undo and recipe reuse do not leak scene-specific references.
issues.verification: Layer recomposition vectors and before/after flatten render comparisons.

issues.title: Add atomic multi-object painting and LOD color propagation

requirements.description: Controlled multi-object strokes and previewed LOD paint propagation

issues.problem: Repeating the same authoring task across kit pieces and LODs is error-prone.
issues.solution: Add explicitly selected multi-target painting/recipes and LOD propagation using validated correspondence, with per-target capability/mismatch reports.
success: Shared source meshes remain isolated; mixed unsupported selections are reported before commit.
A multi-target gesture is one Undo and cannot partially apply after preflight failure.
LOD transfer reports coverage/error and never assumes equal vertex order.
Bounds, transforms, prefabs and mixed material profiles have recorded acceptance.
issues.verification: Mixed-selection atomicity, shared-mesh isolation and LOD reference fixtures.

issues.title: Add UV texture-mask painting for sparse meshes

requirements.description: Texture-mask painting independent of vertex density

issues.problem: Adding geometry is not always an acceptable answer to small-detail painting.
issues.solution: Add an explicitly separate texture-mask workflow with UV diagnostics, chosen resolution/channel layout, source-copy creation and clear distinction from vertex painting.
success: A low-poly cube can receive localized face detail without subdivision on a supported UV layout.
Overlapping/missing UVs, seams, color space and resolution/memory cost are surfaced before authoring.
Source textures are never overwritten implicitly; strokes, saving, reload and export are reversible/recoverable.
Vertex-only/custom-shader workflows remain available without forced texture allocation.
issues.verification: UV seam/overlap fixtures, stroke Undo tests and sparse-cube comparison scene.

issues.title: Prototype and qualify depth-aware blend rendering

requirements.description: Depth-aware material blending with bounded quality modes

issues.problem: The current blend toolkit cannot offer depth-aware transitions; publisher demonstrations are not proof of a shipping baseline.
issues.solution: Prototype an original depth-aware approach, compare it against height-only/POM, then implement a bounded supported mode with optional high-detail-to-lower-LOD transfer.
success: Document whether the chosen approach changes UVs, depth, silhouettes or geometry; do not conflate them.
Measure visual benefit, shader cost and artifacts at grazing angles and intersecting surfaces.
Unsupported APIs/pipelines have an explicit fallback; experimental work is not advertised as supported.
Qualify fixed-camera editor/player/shadow/depth results before checking off this improvement.
issues.verification: Prototype decision record, GPU timing and depth/shadow/reference captures.

issues.title: Run first-use, accessibility and production-task acceptance

requirements.description: Observed usability and accessible authoring acceptance

issues.problem: Unit tests cannot tell whether artists can understand or efficiently use the package.
issues.solution: Run scripted fresh-user and experienced-user tasks against the approved workflow; record time, errors, assistance and blockers, then resolve findings in focused PRs.
success: At least three first-time participants attempt create/material/paint/save/bake tasks; report sample size without claiming statistical certainty.
At least two of three complete the first-stroke lesson in five minutes without verbal help; every critical safety mistake blocks release.
Keyboard, focus, themes, display scaling and shortcut discoverability are inspected.
Record baseline versus final task timings; all blocking UX findings are resolved and retested.
issues.verification: Evidence report with consented anonymized observations and reproducible task scripts.

issues.title: Qualify rendering, performance and platform/dependency combinations

requirements.description: Expanded compatibility, performance and clean consumer evidence

issues.problem: Current observations cover one Windows/URP baseline, not the expanded product.
issues.solution: Define exact Unity/pipeline/API/OS combinations and run clean imports, player builds, rendering, memory and interactive profiling with optional dependencies present/absent.
success: Retain 40k-vertex interactive coverage and add bounded 100k geometry/large-array/boolean fixtures.
Publish hardware, scene, sampling method, p50/p95 and memory; set reviewed budgets before optimizing and fail regressions against them.
Test supported Built-in/URP/HDRP variants and optional ProBuilder/Splines independence; never infer support from compilation alone.
Windows/macOS/Linux are validation targets; unsupported/unobserved cells remain visible and cannot be marketed as tested.
issues.verification: CI plus owner profiler/graphics evidence; carry forward #9/#10 rather than duplicate results.

issues.title: Close the evidence-backed feature ledger before RC and 1.0

requirements.description: Complete advertised-feature coverage and beyond-baseline release gate

issues.problem: A feature count or closed milestone can conceal missing advertised behavior.
issues.solution: Maintain the dated public-source ledger, resolve contradictions, map every row to its implementation PR/tests/manual evidence and block release until all required rows plus selected improvement gates pass.
success: No parity row is closed solely because a file, UI control or automated test exists.
Store/manual discrepancies and inaccessible/demo-only claims remain explicit, with chosen SimpleBlend behavior and evidence.
All M10-M19 issues and M20 usability/qualification acceptance pass before #11; exceptions require an explicit user-approved scope change.
Update #8 redistribution inventory, #9 support matrix and #10 acceptance record for the expanded package; no blanket superiority claim without measurements.
issues.verification: Auditable ledger review and release dependency check against every required issue.
